system.description:
FOCUS VESPERYN

For a few terrible moments the distinction between your living flesh and the vampire lurking within your ancestry becomes dangerously thin.
Action 1 AP; Duration 1 minute
Your vampiric inheritance fully awakens.
For the duration:
You gain Fast Healing 1.
Your land Speed increases by 5 feet.
You gain advantage on Diplomacy, Bluff (Deception) and Demoralise (Intimidate) checks against living humanoids.
If you possess a Bite or Fangs natural attack, it is treated as Magical and inflicts an additional 1d6 essence damage once per round when it successfully inflicts HP damage upon a living creature.
Your skin becomes deathly pale, your eyes visibly change and your fangs lengthen while Blood Awakened is active. These manifestations cannot be convincingly concealed without magic.
Be aware that this ability does not grant the Unliving or Undead trait and does not grant the full immunities, Drink Blood ability or other abilities of an Unliving Vampire.

Prerequisites Level 15

Use (1 AP, Focus): a one-minute effect — +5 ft Speed on your sheet, advantage on Diplomacy, Bluff and Demoralise against living humanoids offered, Fast Healing 1 and the Fangs rider as notes on the card.
